BEFORE YOU REGISTER · THE OPERATIONS MANUAL

One movement, one standard.

The LCASP Summer Impact School 2026 — a Street to Stardom initiative under the Afrovanguard Governing Council — runs 900 learners across 6 Lagos centres under the theme “Ìlú Èkó · Empowered 360°.” Volunteers don't follow the schedule of the public; they set the standard. Here's what you're signing up to.

PILLAR 1
Character
Values, mentorship and foundational ethics.
PILLAR 2
Leadership
Institutional capacity and anti-corruption habits.
PILLAR 3
Skill Acquisition
Hands-on, project-based technical & creative learning.
PILLAR 4
Community Impact
Civic responsibility and local service.
PILLAR 5
Purpose Development
Life vision aligned with Afrocentric impact.

About you

Exactly as on your ID. We use these to contact you and to print your volunteer card.

Volunteers are 16 or older.
A clear headshot — it goes on your volunteer card once you're approved (required) — the site takes the picture; upload or link are optional. Tap the photo to view it larger.
Two referees

People who know you well and are not family: a teacher, an employer, a faith or community leader. We contact them before you work with members.

Safeguarding declaration
Still needed: which programme, pick a role, your centre, first name, last name, a valid email, a phone number, date of birth, sex, a headshot, why you, referees and the safeguarding declaration.
